mapper.select: select a.robot_id robotId, a.robot_code robotCode, a.robot_name robotName, a.robot_status robotStatus, a.last_online_time lastOnlineTime, a.off_line_count offLineCount, a.duration from t_robot_info a where 1 = 1 and a.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} and a.robot_code = #{robotCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT tcp.`camera_id`, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tci.commission_date) + 1 commissionDay, (SELECT COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(tcdr.`createtime`, '%Y-%m-%d') )) cruiseDay, SUM(IF(tcdr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) AS validNum, COUNT(result.task_result_id) totalNum FROM t_camera_preset tcp LEFT JOIN `t_cruise_point_instance` tcpi ON tcp.`preset_id` = tcpi.`cruise_id` LEFT JOIN `t_camera_info` tci ON tci.`camera_id` = tcp.`camera_id` LEFT JOIN `t_cruise_data_result` tcdr ON tcdr.`cruise_id` = tcpi.`instance_id` and tci.commission_date < tcdr.`createtime` LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.cruise_result_id = tcdr.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result result ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id WHERE tci.`commission_date` IS TRUE and tci.`commission_date` <= now() and tcp.camera_id = #{cameraId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY camera_id

SELECT tr.robot_id robotId, tr.robot_code robotCode, DATE_FORMAT(tr.commission_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') commissionDate, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) + 1 commissionDay, COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) taskDay, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) - COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(ta.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) + 1 normalDay FROM t_robot_info tr LEFT JOIN t_robot_alarm ta ON ta.`robot_id` = tr.`robot_id` AND ( ta.alarm_time IS NULL OR ta.alarm_time >= tr.commission_date ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tc ON tc.`robot_id` = tr.`robot_id` LEFT JOIN t_cruise_result tcr ON tcr.`task_id` = tc.`task_id` AND tcr.execute_time <=NOW() WHERE tr.commission_date IS TRUE AND tr.commission_date <= NOW() and tr.robot_type IS TRUE and tr.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY robotId

SELECT tr.robot_id robotId, tr.robot_code robotCode, DATE_FORMAT(tr.commission_date,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') commissionDate, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) + 1 commissionDay, COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(tcr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) taskDay, TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(tr.`commission_date`) - COUNT( DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(ta.alarm_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) + 1 normalDay FROM t_robot_info tr LEFT JOIN t_robot_alarm ta ON ta.`robot_id` = tr.`robot_id` AND ( ta.alarm_time IS NULL OR ta.alarm_time >= tr.commission_date ) LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tc ON tc.`robot_id` = tr.`robot_id` LEFT JOIN t_cruise_result tcr ON tcr.`task_id` = tc.`task_id` AND tcr.execute_time <=NOW() WHERE tr.commission_date IS TRUE AND tr.commission_date <= NOW() and tr.drone_type IS TRUE and tr.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY robotId

select DATE_FORMAT(cruise_task_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, count(1) as totalNum, (select count(1) from t_cruise_task_result where cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and cruise_result = 246) as validNum from t_cruise_task_result where cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by MONTH

select DATE_FORMAT(cruise_task_time, '%u') WEEK, count(1) as totalNum, (select count(1) from t_cruise_task_result where cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and cruise_result = 246) as validNum from t_cruise_task_result where cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by WEEK

select DATE_FORMAT(cruise_task_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) as totalNum, (select count(1) from t_cruise_task_result where cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and cruise_result = 246) as validNum from t_cruise_task_result where cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time`, '%u') WEEK, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time`, '%Y-%m') MONTH, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.`warn_time`, '%Y-%m-%d') day, COUNT(1) AS totalNum, COUNT(t.deal_type) AS validNum FROM (SELECT deal_type, warn_time FROM t_warn_info UNION ALL (SELECT deal_type, defect_time warn_time FROM t_defect_info)) t WHERE t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} GROUP BY day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time, '%u') WEEK, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.warn_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) as totalNum, sum(if(t.deal_type = 286, 1, 0)) as validNum FROM (select deal_type, warn_time from t_warn_info where deal_type is not null union all ( select deal_type, defect_time warn_time from t_defect_info where deal_type is not null )) t where t.warn_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(result.cruise_task_time, '%Y-%m') MONTH, count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(tcdr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result tcdr ON detail.cruise_result_id = tcdr.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tct ON tct.task_id = result.`task_id` WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by MONTH

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(result.cruise_task_time, '%u') WEEK, count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(tcdr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result tcdr ON detail.cruise_result_id = tcdr.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tct ON tct.task_id = result.`task_id` WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(result.cruise_task_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) AS totalNum, sum(IF(tcdr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0)) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result tcdr ON detail.cruise_result_id = tcdr.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tct ON tct.task_id = result.`task_id` WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by day

SELECT count( 1 ) AS totalNum, sum( IF ( tcdr.cruise_result = 247, 1, 0 ) ) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_task_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON detail.task_result_id = result.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result tcdr ON detail.cruise_result_id = tcdr.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task tct ON tct.task_id= result.`task_id` WHERE result.cruise_task_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} and result.task_id = #{taskId} and tct.robot_id = #{robotId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(detail.cruise_time, '%Y-%m-%d') day, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_data_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON result.cruise_result_id = detail.cruise_result_id AND result.cruise_id = detail.instance_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(detail.cruise_time, '%u') WEEK, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_data_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON result.cruise_result_id = detail.cruise_result_id AND result.cruise_id = detail.instance_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by WEEK

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(detail.cruise_time, '%Y-%m') month, count(1) AS totalNum, count(result.identify_result) AS validNum FROM t_cruise_data_result result LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail detail ON result.cruise_result_id = detail.cruise_result_id AND result.cruise_id = detail.instance_id WHERE detail.cruise_time BETWEEN #{startTime} and #{endTime} group by month
